questionEn: What is Al-Kindi known for in the history of chemistry?
questionUz: Al-Kindi kimyo tarixida nimasi bilan mashhur?
choicesEn: The first scientist to criticize alchemy
Author of the periodic table of elements
Creator of the law of conservation of mass
explanationEn: Al-Kindi is the first scientist to criticize alchemy.
explanationUz: Al-Kindi alkimyoni tanqid qilgan birinchi olimdir.
